question: What is the circumference of the International Football Association Board (IFAB) approved football?
solution:
The correct answer is __**68 - 70 cms**__

• The circumference of the International Football Association Board (IFAB) approved football is **68 - 70 cms**.
 
• This standard ensures uniformity in the size of footballs used in official matches across the world.
